title: Genotype QC
description: Detect sample-level genotype defects such as low call rate, contamination, sample swaps and unexpected relatedness, then return a clean sample set.

title: Bulk RNA
description: Normalise and model bulk expression, including latent structure that makes a naive differential-expression analysis confidently wrong.

title: Single cell
description: Work with 10x-style single-cell matrices: cell-type annotation and pseudobulk aggregation under realistic sparsity.

title: QTL
description: Map genetic effects on expression while controlling population structure and calibrating false discovery.

title: Gene networks
description: Infer gene regulatory networks from expression and genotype data, separating direct regulation from latent-confounded correlation.

title: Fine mapping
description: Resolve causal variants from summary statistics and distinguish shared causal signal from coincidental colocalization.

title: Functional annotation
description: Classify variants by regulatory function and estimate stratified heritability enrichment from incomplete public tracks.

title: Integrative
description: Combine bulk, single-cell, genotype and trait data into cell-type-resolved regulatory models and causal estimates.
